title: UAAP: With 2 rounds to go, FEU women secure Season 89 chess crown
summary: Far Eastern University has virtually secured the UAAP Season 89 women's chess championship, thanks to a two-match sweep on Sunday at the BGPOP Building inside the University of Santo Tomas campus.
